title: Case findings record for rule and agent output
scope: Store per-case findings from Jube rules and AI playbooks (code, explanation, rule/playbook version, evidence citations, source, status) as tenant-scoped, append-only Frappe records the officer UI and decisions can read; include analysis provenance (provider, model id, prompt version, fallback level) and officer finding feedback (accepted/modified/rejected with reason)

acceptance.text: A Vati Case Finding DocType (or equivalent) with tenant/case isolation via TAX-029 field names, provenance (rule or playbook id + version, evidence refs) and append-only revisions; no risk/fraud labels on people
Rule signals from TAX-035 and a playbook result for at least SYN-002 can be recorded and read back per case; cross-tenant and taxpayer reads are refused; replay of the same finding is idempotent

Findings and briefings store the TAX-096 analysis provenance; officer feedback on a finding (accepted/modified/rejected with reason) is stored append-only with the actor and is readable by the TAX-070 feedback loop
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Rule signals from TAX-035 and a playbook result for at least SYN-002 can be recorded and read back per case; cross-tenant and taxpayer reads are refused; replay of the same finding is idempotent

evidence.text: Vati Case Finding DocType (backend/vati_tax/vati_tax/vati_tax/doctype/vati_case_finding) keyed by tenant_id + case_id (TAX-029 names, no taxpayer_id, no Vati Taxpayer DocPerm), with producer, producer_version, rule_id/rule_version/ruleset_id/ruleset_version/input_digest or playbook name/version/content_digest/registry_version/run_id, EvidenceRef JSON (evidence ID, stored SHA-256, source-record locator) and append-only revisions (revision, supersedes_finding_id, unique revision_key; controller refuses edits and deletes). Finding text refuses the ADR-026 FORBIDDEN_TERMS (kept equal to scheme_graph by tests/integration/test_case_findings.py). Observed: findings/test_engine.py 27 tests OK; bench FindingBenchTests (6) passed in scripts/frappe_dev.py verify (ADR-041).

store.record_rule_signal records the SYN-002 TAX-035 rows (TR-VAT-REFUND-MISMATCH, TR-RELATED-PARTY-FEES, TR-PERSISTENT-LOSSES; no_signal/not_applicable record nothing) and store.record_playbook_result records the TAX-049 related-party result as 5 cited findings; list_findings/get_finding read them back per case. Taxpayers get PermissionError (refusal kept in the audit ledger) and cannot get_list the DocType; another tenant's auditor gets tenant_scope_denied or not_found. Replays return the stored record (no new rows); a changed body under the same key is idempotency_conflict. Observed: tests/integration/test_case_findings.py 9 tests OK (1 skipped: LangGraph proposal test, LangGraph not installed) on the live tax_risk.evaluate_record and review_related_party output, validated by integration/api/contract.py; python3 scripts/frappe_dev.py verify: Ran 189 bench tests, FAILED (failures=1), the only failure being reminders.test_reminders_bench test_overturned_source_hides_the_reminder, which also fails (with 1 more error) in a baseline run with the findings bench class skipped.

langgraph_run findings require a valid TAX-096 AnalysisProvenance (rules.validate_provenance, checked against contract.py on every example provenance and 19 mutations plus each missing required field); rule and officer findings refuse provenance. Vati Finding Feedback stores accepted/modified/rejected with reason_code, reason (>=10 chars for modified/rejected), modified_explanation (modified only), the session user and role (an actor in the body is a 400), previous_feedback_id for the same officer, a FindingSnapshot of the judged finding and changes_finding false; edits and deletes are refused. engine/store.feedback_for_review returns each item with its TAX-070 provenance entry, which ai/workflows/outcome_feedback._component parses (test_case_findings). NOT YET DONE: no briefing record exists, so briefing provenance is not stored yet; the criterion stays open until one is added. Observed in the same unit, integration and bench runs as criteria 1-2.

PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/278. dev.py check passed; quality.py passed; validate.py passed; bench verify 189 tests with one pre-existing reminders failure (same in baseline without the findings tests).
